threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can spot the newcomers by their confusion over the 149 bus route – it goes the long way round, but they think it's a direct line.
Caught a whiff of fresh jerk chicken on the 35 last night. Turns out, the guy in the back had a whole takeaway feast. Smelled better than the bus itself.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: One morning, I saw a guy feeding pigeons while juggling. The birds didn’t care. That’s when I realized this place is wonderfully weird.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do kebab shops serve vegan versions alongside traditional meat, and nightclubs have secret rooftop gardens. It's a wild mix.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local when they don't flinch at the BART delays but still grumble about the 14 bus being late again. Only true riders know the struggle.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy on the 47 bus arguing with the driver about a late transfer. Whole bus was in on it, shouting their own grievances. Classic Muni chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just stroll into any bar and find a table. In Gràcia, you better get there early or prepare to stand, especially on a weekend.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones at the market, bewildered by the lack of plastic bags, clutching their organic avocados like treasures.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still get confused by the bus routes and end up on the 38 when you meant to take the 55. Classic new arrival move.
Caught the night bus home last week and a guy was trying to sell a broken umbrella as a 'one-of-a-kind masterpiece.' No one bought it, but he didn’t stop his pitch.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw an old man feeding pigeons while vigorously arguing with a street artist about who painted the best mural—it felt like home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find a Kebab shop next to an art gallery, where the scent of grilled meat mingles with fresh paint. Truly, Berlin's contrasts shine here.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they still call it the ‘BART Station’ and not the ‘Civic Center’ after all the closures. Someone from here feels the train’s pain.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus today that made a hard stop, sending a guy’s sandwich flying. He just stared at it, blank, while we all tried not to laugh.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: You’ll see tourists in the parks all day but miss how locals sit at the same corner café, sipping a caña and catching up. It’s the real Gràcia vibe.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still staring at the metro map like it’s a cryptic treasure map, trying to decipher where the next L1 stop is.
